scope: Feasibility of the existing Qwen baseline and currently prepared evaluators; runnable does not mean accurate or a full reproduction of a paper.

definitions.Runnable now: Documented frozen execution and scorer exist, including already installed fixed specialist evaluators where used. Does not authorize rerunning or guarantee valid/nonzero outcomes.
definitions.compatible: Qwen can accept the documented text/image input and express the required output in an existing or prospectively qualified adaptation. Missing data/evaluators can still block readiness; no claim of exact specialist training/architecture replication.
definitions.needs specialist pipeline: The native task requires trained latent representations, non-chat modality/coordinate components or task-specific learned heads beyond current Qwen text/vision serving.
definitions.unresolved: The required Qwen API/output interface itself has not yet been sufficiently validated.
definitions.usesExternalEvaluator: Requires an additional learned/specialist evaluator or human/LLM judging beyond deterministic metric code. True does not mean that evaluator is missing; P42 has its frozen evaluator prepared.

important_limits: Readiness refers to executable inputs and scoring, not whether Qwen produces correct predictions.
Vision is supported; image input alone is not a blocker.
Some existing evaluations use prepared external scorers, including the fixed SaProt fluorescence oracle for GFP.
Protein folding, coordinate generation, docking, simulations and measured binding assays are not supplied by ordinary Qwen text/vision inference.
Catalog-only sequence/QA datasets still require exact datasets, splits and scoring protocols before running.
